objective: Realize the accepted grounding-event kernel as a short continuous picture-book page sequence with fully closed dialogue exchanges.
realization_rules: Preserve the kernel exactly: only Ninereeds and Taro, direct teaching interaction, stable names, and noncanonical instructional chronology.
Use at least three pages and include initial_state, meaningful_development, and resolution. Four compact two-turn pages are acceptable.
Use only forms in language_fit.forms_naturally_used. Do not add affirmative, negative, OR, instructions, captions, labels, or narration as learner-facing text.
Every initiation must have exactly one later explicit response. Mark the reply exchange_role=response and responds_to with the initiating turn ID.
Do not create a response to an unasked question or leave a greeting, question, or meeting acknowledgment unanswered.
A coherent realization may use greeting/reply, Taro asks identity/Ninereeds self-identifies, Ninereeds asks identity/Taro self-identifies, then meeting acknowledgment/reciprocal acknowledgment.
Ninereeds may only say I'm Ninereeds. Taro may only say I'm Taro. Do not ask Ninereeds to impersonate a character.
Visual events and scene facts must be directly depictable and must not invent location, biography, embodiment, relationship, or extra world state.
Bind both participants persistently on every page.
required_output: One closed JSON object following story-pages.template.json and copying required_input_bindings exactly.
decision_rule: Pass only if every page belongs to the same event, every initiation is closed, and no language or world claim exceeds the accepted kernel. Otherwise alarm.
